builds.name: Lady of quads
builds.desc:
As the name suggests, this build aims to quad every target it attacks. It should then trigger galeforce with the help of wrath in order to make another quad against a different target. Using this build Mia can shred through almost any target that does not have the power to kill her in one hit in retaliation to her first two attacks.
For her boon, +spd is optimal in order to hit quads almost every time, but +atk can allow more damage at the cost of less matchups where this Mia will quad. Any non spd or atk bane is OK, but -res is optimal in order to allow her to survive more damage from melee retaliation.
Brave sword+ is the key to this build, as it allows her to make 4 attacks against targets which in turn allows her to proc galeforce very frequently while still putting out incredible damage.
Galeforce is the keystone of this build as it allows Mia to move and attack again, which she can do frequently with the combination of wrath's cooldown reduction and making 4 attacks against her target.
Anything that improves speed and attack works for her A skill as it improves damage and gives her more good matchups.
Wrath gives cooldown reduction that is essential to Mia using galeforce every turn.
A threaten speed or defense gives her more killing power, by improving quad matchups or increasing her own damage.
A speed seal improves more matchups, and quickened pulse allows her to use galeforce on her first round without having wrath active.

builds.name: She can't stop attacking
builds.desc:
Obviously, the main Goal with this Build is to make use of Mia's Speed and her special A-Skill Flashing Blade 3 to make her one of the very few characters who can use Galeforce effectivly in Battle. In order for this set to run perfectly, i highly recommend to use her alongside Dorcas with his Infantery Pulse.
The idea is very simple, yet effective: Mia will start every battle with Galeforce on 3 cooldown (2 if you use the Killing Edge+), so it will trigger on her very first turn if she
A: Doubles her opponent
B: Get hit by a counterattack
C: If you run Killing Edge+, Galeforce will always trigger as long as you have 1 Spd more then the opponent.
Here is the more in-depth description:
Her best IV is obviously +Spd in order to trigger Galeforce more reliably, an Atk+ is also good of course.
For her bone, i would recommend -Res as she should do her best to survive at least one counterattack (expecially in Arena Defense)
For her weapon i recommend Resolute Blade, because usually you will trigger Galeforce on your first move even when you start with cooldown 3. Although it does NOT trigger its in-built Wrath effect, it still provides the most power because of its boost of +3 Atk on top of its 16 might and Mia's extremely high Attack. If you dont happen to have a Dorcas although to reduce her cooldown on turn 1, maybe Killing Edge+ is the prefered choice. With its might of 11, it should be enough to kill most enemys in the 2 turns you can attack.
Reposition because why not
Obviously we take Galeforce as her special, because thats all this set is about. If you might need just brute might in some situations however, you can think about using Astra instead, as in combination with her Resolute Blade it completely demolishes almost the whole cast with one single blow.
Flashing Blade 3 is essential in this build as it allows to charge Mia's special in one turn if you are faster than your opponent (which is all this set is about, triggering Galeforce as soon/often as possible).
I recommend Desperation 3 for her B-Special, because if you manage to get in the HP-treshold for Desperation, Mia just turns even deadlier, often OHKO her opponents without being threatened by a Counterattack.
Here you could play around a little bit tho, as Swordbreaker 3 or even Lancebreaker 3 MIGHT be an alternative, improving her survivability in some cases.
Now, the C-skill is rather interesting. You can go for usual team boost skills like Hone Atk or Hone Spd, but in my opinion, expecially if you want to use her in an Arena-Defense team where the only goal is to eliminate only 1 opponent, Savage Blow 3 is a very interesting choice as it damages opponents other than the initial target (which could come in handy if she then tries to kill another opponent than the first one). Another idea is to play Attack Smoke 3 to lower the opponents offensive options after her combat, although in my opinion it is not worth to sacrifice a Brave Lyn for this.
And last, but defenetly not least as it is crucial for this build we have Quickened Pulse as her Sacred Seal Special. (I don't think i have to explain this one)
The last thing i want to talk about are Mia's "optimal" teammates, or at least some very good options for her.
I use of course Dorcas, as he reduces her Special Cooldown by 1 on the first turn. Again, if you are not lucky enough to have a Dorcas, you should use the Killing Edge+ instead of her Resolute Blade.
Second is basically any Dancer, although i prefere Performing Arts Azura (with Wings of Mercy 3 ) as she provides her allies with buffs while she dances.
As her third ally, i came up with Trick-or-Treat Nowi with a very simple idea: i wanted to have the highest and most unpredictable movement options possible.
For this, my build is a Warpgate Nowi with Grimoire to warp to allies 2 spaces away when above 50% HP, Wings of Mercy 3 to help out allies in trouble and Guidiance 3 to let the other members of the team get nearby her and maybe secure a kill (which again is the only real goal for an arena defence team)
I hope my explanations were clear and understandable :)

builds.name: Mia > Ayra
builds.desc: This build has the soul purpose of doubling almost every unit in the game, including Ayra. Keep in mind some people have merged units effecting the outcome of this build, as well as inflated stats in TT, Squad Assault, and Chain Challenge.

builds.name: Whirlwind of singing steel!
builds.desc:
With this build and a +Atk IV, she gets a massive 59 atk, making it very easy to get the heavy blade bonus, this build focuses on getting into the desperation range and using it combined with her special to eliminate almost any unit. Moonbow and Glimmer yield very similar results, I recommend using Moonbow if you go with threaten speed and Glimmer if you go with threaten def or want to use her in modes where enemy HP is inflated. A +spd IV can be used and she'll have 48 speed, making doubling units very easy, especially given speed buffs.
The reason I recommend -HP is so that it's easier to get into desperation, she'll have 34 HP and only needs to take 9 damage to hit the desperation range, with summoner support this goes to 39, which means she'll have to take at least 10 damage, which, considering her defenses are in the low 20s, isn't very hard.
As with any build, it has weaknesses: Mia's low HP and low defenses due to L&D3 can make it hard for her to survive a hit to get into the desperation range; Anything that prevents her from doubling completely (+Deflect Melee 3 but no one uses that) ruins Mia, unless she has her special ready in which case she may be able to just get the KO; Vantage is also a problem for Mia, though usually she'll be taking an enemy from full HP and Mia can't support her allies in any way (unless they have Ally support). These weaknesses can be circumvented by running support units and counters with her.
This build gets even stronger with merges and especially summoner support, my Mia is +Spd, +1 merged and has summoner support, resulting in 58 atk and 51 spd without any other modifiers. If mine were +Atk, she'd have 61 atk and 48 spd, which is still massive, but I enjoy seeing a spd stat over 50.
I hope this graceful whirlwind of singing steel proves very useful for you as she has for me!

builds.name: The Quading Madwomen
builds.desc:
The basic idea behind this build is to use Mia's massive speed stat to active specials like its going out of style, and be a somewhat different take on quad builds.
For her IV's +spd is by far her best option. With a +spd nature, she has a whopping 43 base speed,which makes activating flashing blade a breeze for her. +atk can also work, but those extra points in speed will usually make more of a difference than in attack. -hp is taken as she needs less damage to get into desperation range.
For her weapon we go with Brave Sword+. With her massive speed, she can quad attack many foes with ease.
For her assist Drawback is a solid option to help with positioning. Ardent Sacrifice is also an option if you want her to get into desperation range with having to engage an enemy herself.
For her special Moonbow is preferred. With flashing blade she can get it off twice on most engagements, so even higher def units will have to watch out. Luna is another option that comes in her base kit, but she won't be able to get it off quite as often as moonbow.
For her A passive we go with her native Flashing Blade. Not only is it one of Mia's best options in general, it is a key component of this build. As stated above, it allows her to activate specials such as moonbow twice in one engagement if she has five more speed than the enemy, something which will happen very often for Mia. For her B we go with Desperation. Pretty standard for quad builds, allows her to get in all of her attacks before the enemy can retaliate. Few foes will be able to survive four attacks from her, two of which would be moonbows, to be able to attack her back afterwards. For her C we go with Threaten Spd. This helps her outspeed even more enemies than she could otherwise.
For her seal we go with Spd +3. With a +spd boon this will put her at 41 speed with the brave sword. VERY few units will have enough speed for her not to quad them, even more so with threaten speed.

builds.name: Amplified Blade
builds.desc:
The Amplified Blade build is made of the following and it’s like it’s default skill set but better. The +Spd/-Atk iv can put an end to most people except heavily armored knights, which the minimum damage will be 5.
Weapon of Choice: Resolute Blade. The reason I chose this was because of the built in Attack plus and the extra 10 damage this makes her specials do extra damage and mostly making out of life and death situations.
Assist: Reposition. A basic movement supplement that can grant a equal support skill if you want to move a even stronger ally away from powerful opponents.
Special: Luna. The default skill set can lead to repeated use of it if needed. Alternatively you can use Aether for the healing capability if you want to play safe.
Passive 1: Flashing Blade 4. An amplified version of Flashing Blade 3, doing extra damage if you’re faster than the opponent which is mostly the case.
Passive 2: Wrath 3. If you want extra damage from your specials use wrath and with other special boosted by Resolute Blade the total bonus damage will be 20 therefore it is a great asset to special damage. Alternatively you can use Vantage 3 to make her attack first so you can get a special attack in.
Passive 3: Even Spd Wave 3 or Odd Spd Wave 3. They grant Mia a great boost of speed and you can make her attack at either the even or odd turns.
Seal: Speed +3. Extra speed adds the possibility of countering faster character such as Mareeta: The Blade's Pawn Karla: Sword Vassal or Byleth: Proven Professor by overwhelming them in speed.
Overall: This build is speed based not power based using skills to overwhelm and relentless special attacking to take down enemies.
builds.c: Odd Spd Wave 3 / Even Spd Wave 3
